_doc: Public-domain field recordings behind the biome ambience loops (D26) and the toucan one-shots (D31). Every item is from archive.org's radio-aporee-maps collection under CC0 or the Public Domain Mark, so this file is both the build input and the attribution record. `start` = null lets tools/ingest_amb.py pick the best-looping window automatically; set it to a number of seconds to pin one. Run: python3 tools/ingest_amb.py (loops), python3 tools/ingest_toms.py (one-shots). `alternates` keeps every source that was ever shipped or auditioned — a `retired` note says why one lost the slot.
